Name: Talkohlooeys Style Shiko NPC Portrait
Author: RamonXick
Description:
[center]﻿[size=4] Talkohloeeys Style Portraits for Shiko - New Custom NPC[/size][/center]﻿

[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/4ukMVq5.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url] - For old ver.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] For latest ver.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko - New Custom NPC[/url][/size]

[size=3]Recomended mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4938]Shiko Portraits by zaira048[/url] for Sprite

[/size]Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract to Mods folder, or use your favourite Mod Manager
3. Run the game using SMAPI
4. Choose your prefered hair color via Generic Mod Menu
